亞德客-KY 為氣動元件製造大廠 
 亞德客-KY 為氣動元件製造大廠 
亞德客-KY 為氣動元件製造大廠，主要競爭優勢來自於低階大量產品生產，取
得規模經濟後轉向中高階產品生產，為具有生產經濟規模與兼具品質之廠商。
主要廠區：寧波廠生產氣動元件部件整合與汽缸元件與大型線軌；廣東廠生產
氣動元件之氣閥；台灣台南廠生產較高端之汽缸與線軌。主要競爭對手為日商
SMC。2025 公司營收區域別：中國 94%、海外 4%、台灣 2%。2025 產業別
佔比：電子設備 26%、電池行業 20%、能源與照明設備 3%、通用機械 7%、
包裝機械 7%、汽車製造 9%、機床製造 5%、其他 23%。

 3Q26 電子與汽車行業拉貨動能強勁，調整稅後 EPS 至 14.48 元 
展望後市，終端市場：電子產業受惠 AI 相關設備投資、客戶新產品推出及規
格升級，需求維持雙位數成長；汽車產業持續透過市占率提升帶動成長；電池
受惠 ESS 需求及中國廠商海外擴產，維持強勁復甦，管理層表示 7 月出貨維
持強勁，優於原 先預期。氣動元件持續擴增中國市占率，目前訂單能見度約
2-3 個月；線軌需求穩步改善，稼動率已提升至 40%以上，目標於 2026 年底
提升至 50%，總結前述，當前接單金額大於出貨金額，雖第三季受傳統淡季
影響營收將較第二季回落，但在去年基期偏低下，年增率仍可望維持強勁表
現。獲利部分，受惠生產效率持續提升、產品組合改善及氣動元件稼動率維持
高檔，毛利率可望維持穩健，在費用控管得宜，不考慮一次性業外損益下，調
整稅後 EPS 至 14.48 元(原 13.01 元)。

Caterpillar, Inc. (CAT-US)  
財報 FIRST TAKE —單季營收史上首度突破 200 億美元，AI 相關業務需求強，股價上漲 5.6%

資料來源：Factset，Bloomberg 
 評論及分析： 
工業龍頭 CAT 業績遠超預期並上調預期。開盤前一度大漲超過 9%，惟後續
拉回收漲 5.6%。市場觀察 CAT 主要挑戰包括：訂單積壓強勁，但未來上行
力度或更多挑戰；雖然業績亮眼，但有一次性因素；下半年利潤率改善路徑
仍有待觀察。考量 CAT 目前所有業務都呈現穩健成長，而非僅靠 AI 相關，
看到基礎設施⽀出、租賃⾞隊、採礦投資以及 AI 驅動的電力需求將⽀撐成
長。產能擴張計劃不完全依賴 資料中⼼，還涵蓋⽯油天然氣、採礦、海運以
及不斷增長的裝機基礎，未來望獲得售後市場服務收入的機會。 
公司財報重點數據： 
2Q26 營收達 205.4 億美元，年成長 24%，為公司歷史上首次單季營收突破
200 億美元。調整後 EPS 為 8.17 美元，年增 73%，高於市場預期 6.20 美
元；調整後營業利益 45 億美元，調整後營業利益率 21.9%，年增 430 個基
點。積壓訂單達 721 億美元，季增超過 90 億美元，其中 59%預計於未來 12
個月內交付。公司透過股票回購與股息共返還股東 22 億美元資本。2Q26 關
稅成本(不含 IEEPA 退稅)約 4 億美元，優於 4 月估計的 7 億美元，本季另認
列 IEEPA 關稅退稅 3.92 億美元  
公司業績表現： 
(1).電力與能源：營收 82.4 億美元，年增 17%，發電營收年增 29%，主因資
料中⼼用大型往復式引擎(Large Reciprocating Engines )、渦輪機及相關服
務需求強勁；⽯油與天然氣營收年增 9%；工業用引擎營收年增 9%。終端用
戶銷售整體年增 33%， 其中發電終端銷售年增高達72%。 為因應資料中⼼用
電需求 ， 公司宣布恢復生產10MW 中速燃氣往復式引擎平台 ， 新增約1.5GW
產能，第四季開始出貨；惟部分產品交期已延伸至 2028 至 2029 年，顯示產
能仍偏緊。 
(2).建築：營收 83.5 億美元，年增 35%，分區域來看，北美年增 50%，拉丁
美洲年增 25%，歐非中東年增 23%，亞太年增 3%。終端用戶銷售連續第六
季成長，年增 22%，主要受惠於北美租賃機隊裝載強勁及非住宅、住宅營建
設備銷售暢旺 。 本季公司首度交付設備予Major Projects(與經銷商合資成立 、
聚焦大型基礎建設專案的全國性租賃平台） 。 管理層提及中東地區終端需求偏
軟，為區域表現中的隱憂。 
(3).資源：營收 46.5 億美元，年增 20%，終端用戶銷售年增 17%，礦業、重
型營建及砂⽯骨材需求皆優於去年同期，鐵路業務成長則來自國際機⾞交付
增加。 
(4).金融產品：營收 11.5 億美元，年增 10%，客戶財務體質維持穩健，逾期
繳款比率降至 1.31%，為 1998 年以來最低；備抵呆帳比率降至 0.84%，創
歷史新低。 
複委託報告 August 5, 2026

公司展望與產業前景：
(1).全年營收成長展望由先前的低雙位數上修至中高雙位數。
(2).全年調整後營業利益率展望優於先前預期，下半年關稅對調整後營業利益
與利益率的衝擊預計不顯著，公司不再預期下半年會有額外的 IEEPA 關稅退
稅，全年關稅成本從原先預估 22 到 24 億美元下修至約 22 億美元。
(3).全年 ME&T 自由現金流展望上修至 60 億至 150 億美元目標區間的上半
段；儘管資本⽀出增加，下半年 ME&T 自由現金流預估仍將略高於上半年。
2026 年資本⽀出預估約 35 億美元，與先前預期相近。
(4).管理層表示 ，AI 資料中⼼帶動的發電設備需求為主要成長動能之一 ， 電力
與能源客戶訂單能見度已延伸至 2030 年，但仍面臨產能吃緊、部分產品交
付期延長。建築產業下半年經銷商庫存水位可能對銷售量成長構成壓力，第
四季通常會出現季節性庫存去化。

電話會議 Q&A 重點摘要：
(1).資料中⼼以外的引擎與渦輪機訂單是否也在走強，動能延續性：管理層表

示在⽯油與天然氣、尤其是天然氣壓縮領域看到強勁需求，預期未來幾年天
然氣輸送量將大幅提升；大型引擎同時應用於採礦設備與船舶市場，目前尚
未看到任何客戶減少需求，訂單積壓反而持續拉長。

售持續正成長即屬正面訊號，管理層對下半年展望偏樂觀。
(3).未來二至四季，建築產業銷售量成長是否放緩 ：管理層表示建築產業在
2025 年上半年基期較低、下半年才加速成長並延續至 2026 年上半年，此基
期效應須納入下半年年增率比較考量。

圖一：華邦電記憶體資本支出

資料來源：華邦電，群益投顧預估整理 
華邦電在矽電容發展較預期佳：  
華邦電的矽電容起初並非獨立規劃的生意，而是華邦電在開發客製化記憶
體 (Cube) 時，為解決電壓驟降 (voltage drop) 而提供給客戶的保護電路。由於
產品規格極佳，部分非客製化記憶體的客戶進而主動要求試作，華邦電順勢
將其發展成一項獨立產品。  
隨著 AI、先進封裝 (如 CoWoS 等 )及細微穩壓 (1.2 伏、 0.9 伏以下 )的需求爆
發，矽電容因具備極小、極薄、耐高溫且電容值精準的特性，迅速成為解決
封裝雜訊與穩壓的最佳方案。  
華邦電矽電容的規格：目前正進行小量產的規格為  3,300 nF/mm ²，而最新
送樣的規格已達到  5,400 nF/mm ²。台積電的量產規格為 2,500 nF/mm ²(主
要用於其  interposer 上供客戶使用 )，其他同業則約在  1,500 nF/mm ²。華 邦
電在此領域具備顯著的領先優勢，並預期很快會成為全球最大的供應商。  
為避免矽電容生產擠壓到利潤更好的 DRAM 產能，華邦電特別為矽電容開
闢獨立的生產專線。公司先前已針對此專線投資約新台幣  40 億元，但產能
一開出便售光，目前高雄廠的矽電容產能已呈現滿載狀態，公司正積極尋找
新的空間進行擴產 。 由於矽電容的前景看好，目前已有數家原先製造  MLCC 
的廠商轉而進入此領域，並成為華邦電該項服務的客戶。  
相較於生產需要耗時 170 天的  DRAM ，矽電容的生產 cycle time 只需要 30
天。在相同的生產時間內， DRAM 跑 1 個生產 cycle ，矽電容則可以跑 5 個
cycle ，這大幅提升設備的周轉率。  
華邦電原本預期矽電容在  2027 年時能占  DRAM 營收的  10% 。然而由於
DRAM 本身的營收分母在近期成長得太大 ， 要達到  10% 的占比變得困難 ，
目前評估能維持  5% 營收占比。不過，矽電容發展的絕對總金額與公司原
先計畫的預期差不多，公司依舊看好其長期的成長動能。  
價格維持高檔，預估華邦電 2026 年營收 2,615.23 億元， YoY+192.51% ，稅
後獲利 1,118.29 億元， YoY+2,722.59% ，稅後 EPS 24.85 元：

華邦電在 AI 邊緣運算方面，提供 CUBE(Customized Ultra Bandwidth
Element) 方案，並參加 UCIe 聯盟，華邦電自主開發高頻寬 CUBE 記憶體，
適用於邊緣 AI 應用， AI、 HPC 領域的  3D TSV DRAM ，華邦電目前 CUBE
在概念驗證 (POC) 階段，先在台中廠試做中，先以 25Snm 開發，後續會以
20nm/16nm 製程生產，可提供每顆晶片 256Mb~16Gb 容量， 2026 年有 16nm
製程， 2027 年可望貢獻營收， Hybrid bump WoW 可以推到 8 顆，再去切，
是以 good die base 出貨。華邦電之前與聯電 (2303 TT) 等合作夥伴成立晶圓
對晶圓 (wafer-to-wafer, W2W) 3D IC 專案，協助客戶加速 3D 封裝產品生
產。此項合作案聯電負責 CMOS 晶圓製造和晶圓對晶圓混合封裝技術；華
邦電導入客製化超高頻寬元件  (Customized Ultra- Bandwidth Elements, 
CUBE) 架構，用於邊緣運算 AI 設備，實現在各種平台和介面上的無縫部署，
但目前尚未出貨。  
管理層明確定位其角色更接近  ASIC ，配合客戶  XPU 進行  3D 封裝，使
華邦電與大宗  DRAM 商品市場的供給溢出效應脫鉤 。 一旦  CUBE 2027 年
起放量，公司的訂價邏輯將不再跟隨  DRAM 現貨市場起伏，而是依附在客
戶的  AI 晶片投資週期之上，這是一種更具黏性、更高毛利的客戶關係結
構。  
Code Storage Flash 方面， NOR Flash 供給在高容量終端需求帶動下持續偏
緊，推升價格於 1H26 起維持有利的上行趨勢。 SLC NAND 供給短缺態勢
亦升溫，支撐價格在  2026 年後延續上漲動能。主要成長來自  伺服器、車
用、 AI 相關應用。在消費端，隨  TWS 等應用功能複雜化，具備較小尺寸
優勢的  45nm Flash 持續推動  Design-in 。新產品自  2Q26 起， 24nm SLC 
NAND 將逐步帶來顯著的營收貢獻。    
Customized Memory Solution (CMS) 方面， DDR4 / LPDDR4 存在結構性供
給缺口，預期將延續至  2028 年以後，短期供給改善空間有限。在供給吃緊
及  AI 需求 (資料中心、 Edge AI 等 )挹注下， 2Q26 價格上漲空間明顯，對
2H26 至  2027 年維持正向展望。眾多客戶的系統單晶片 (SoC) 仍採用  22nm 
或  14nm 製程，短期內難以支援  DDR5 ，使  DDR4 需求得以延續  。隨著
三大原廠將製程升級至  14nm 以下，受限於  ECC 補償機制的技術差異，
已無法回頭量產  DDR4 。隨著大廠逐步淡出供給，現有產能已不足以滿足市
場長期的結構性需求，這正驅動  DDR4 與  DDR3 的合約價持續攀升，且
漲勢預期將一路延續至  2026 年底  。在應用端，智慧家庭、無人機、 M2M 
及網通設備在  2026 年的需求極為看好，電視相關應用需求亦維持健康。特
別是  20nm 製程在  2025 年呈現指數型成長，營收占比已達  55% ，這股成
長動能預計將持續貫穿整個  2026 年。  
過去簽  LTA 的主要是華邦電的直接客戶 (EC1) ，但 1Q26 管理層明確指出，
連二、三線終端廠商 (EC2、EC3) 乃至整車廠原廠，都開始繞過中間層直接找
上華邦電要求簽署長達三年的合約，部分  DDR4 客戶甚至提出 7-10 年的
超長期鎖貨需求。這種行為在供應鏈中屬於高度罕見，清楚說明市場對
DDR4 中長期供應的焦慮已從系統廠蔓延至整個生態鏈末端。對華邦電而
言， LTA 需求的激增提升營收能見度。  
Samsung 、 SK Hynix 、 Micron 陸續退出  2D NAND(SLC ／ MLC) 市場，將資
源集中於  3D NAND 高容量產品。這對華邦電而言，競爭者主動騰出的利
基空間，使其在  SLC NAND 的定價主導權顯著提升。 DRAM 端亦是相同

續至  2H26 。 NOR Flash 受惠於 AI 伺服器，單台新世代機架估計需使用約
500 – 600 顆  NOR Flash 、車用等強勁需求，高容量  NOR Flash 市場持續
供不應求，將推升價格上行趨勢至  2026 年以後。由於華邦電在  NOR Flash 
市場穩居全球第一市占率 (約  23%) ，公司表示會兼顧市場份額與客戶關係，
不會主動帶頭大幅漲價。  
華邦電基本不參與波動較大的現貨市場，主要採行季度合約報價 (quarterly 
base) 。所有產品全數以合約價成交、不走現貨市場，顯示公司對後續定價走
勢具有相當程度的掌控力。由於管理階層預期 2027 年的記憶體供應將會比
2026 年更加吃緊。公司在滿足客戶基本合約需求後，選擇在 2Q26 適度調
控與減少出貨量，將部分產品留到後續再出貨，以因應未來幾年產能吃緊的
市況並發揮最大商業價值。預估華邦電 2026 年稅後 EPS 24.85 元。

台光電 (2383 TT) 
高速 CCL 王者，2026-2028 年獲利高速成長

永豐觀點 
台光電通吃 ASIC AI Server 訂單，高階料號市占率 38.6%全球第一，2Q26 毛利
率創高令人驚艷，中線在 800G、1.6T Switch 產品週期推升下 2026 年獲利持續
創高，長線 M9 料號貢獻，2026-2028 年獲利高速成長。 
 投資評價與建議 
台光電在 AI Server 接單無虞下產能吃緊，2Q26 毛利率創高來到 33.9%優於預
期，，長線而言M9 於 2H26 貢獻營運規格升級趨勢不變，公司亦規劃 2028 年底
月產能擴充至 1110 萬張較 2026 年增加 80.4%，營運價量齊揚態勢不變，研究部
上調 2026-2028 年稅後 EPS 至 115.37、211.35 以及 339.22 元，投資建議維持
買進，目標價上調至 6340 元(30X2027 EPS)。

ESG 評析 
台光電企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向
平均得分分別為 B+等與 B+等。

### Page 2

2

台光電為國內專業銅箔基板廠商，主要產品包含銅箔基板、黏合片(PP)以及多層壓
合基板，2Q26 終端應用為行動裝置(10-15%)、基礎設施(75-80%)、以及汽車/工
業/其他(5-10%)，過去公司主要強項在無鹵素材料以及手機 PP 配方，由於 PP 毛
利率高於平均且隨著 iPhone 滲透率提升帶動公司營運逐年成長 ， 公司亦積極轉型
往基地台、Server 等網通以及車用相關應用發展，並成為通吃 GPU 及 ASIC AI 
server CCL 供應商。公司下游客戶為華通、臻鼎-KY、欣興以及健鼎等終端客戶包
含 Samsung、APPLE、華為、Cisco，主要競爭對手為聯茂、台燿、Doosan 以及
Panasonic。 
2Q26 毛利率 33.9%創高，本業表現令人驚豔：台光電 2Q26 稅後 EPS 27.55 元，
優於研究部原先預估的 22.15 元水準，其中毛利率較 1Q26 增加 4.5 個百分點來
到 33.9%創高並優於預期 3.1 個百分點，主要原因來自稼動率維持滿載、產品組合
轉佳以及漲價效應，其中受惠 AI server 需求暢旺，基礎設施占比來到 75-85%，
帶動 M7 以上高階料號佔比從 1Q26 的 55-60%進一步提升至 60-65%， 即便6 月
第二次漲價未完全反映，本業表現仍令人驚艷。 
AI 需求撐腰， 3Q26 營收 QoQ+21.1% ： 台光電 7 月營收 192.07 億元
(+8.3%MoM，+129.4%YoY)整體 3Q26 營收達成率 33.6%符合預期，研究部認
為 3Q26 除了 AI server 需求推動 M7 以上高階料號占比提升至 65-70%外，6 月
份 漲 價 效 應 亦 可 望 完 整 季 度 貢 獻 ， 預 估 營 收572.44 億元 (+21.1%QoQ ，
+127.7%YoY)，毛利率在稼動率滿載及產品組合轉佳下提升至 35.5%，稅後淨利
128.83 億元(+30.54%QoQ，+254.3%YoY)，單季稅後 EPS 35.96 元(原估 25.37
元)。 
2H26 仍具漲價空間，上調 2026 年稅後 EPS 至 115.37 元：台光電基礎設施產品
線毛利率優於公司平均水準，其中 AI server 占 55-60%、General server 占 15-
20%、Switch 占 15-20%、LEO 占 15-20%，整體櫃間傳輸以及 Agentic AI 帶動
的 General server 等泛 AI 需求達 75-80%，展望 2026 年不論 GPU 及 ASIC 陣營
相關需求不墜，稼動率持續維持滿載，另一方面 M7 以上 CCL 在供給吃緊下擴產
能見度已達 2028 年，2H26 仍具漲價空間，研究處上調台光電 2026 年營收至
1942.72 億元 (+106.1%YoY) ，毛利率 34.3% ， 稅 後 淨 利413.36 億元
(+182.2%YoY)，稅後 EPS 115.37 元(原估 84.89 元)。

### Page 3

3

M9 於 2H26 問世 ，CCL 料號升級趨勢不變： 台光電於2020 年來積極切入 Server、
Switch 以及 AI Server 等高速傳輸領域持續侵蝕同業聯茂(6213 TT) 和台燿(6274 
TT)於 Server 及 Switch 市占，2023 年並成為美系 AI Server 首輪供應商，帶動相
關基礎設施產線於2Q26 達 75-80%，毛利率超越 Handheld 成為全公司最佳，長
線而言隨著 ASIC AI Server 以及 800G、1.6T Switch 產品週期推升，M8 比重將於
2025 年攀升，而M9 亦將於 2H26 問世並占比低個位數，公司產品組合轉佳趨勢不
變。 
AI server 需求強勁，擴產規畫達 2028 年：隨著 AI Server 於高速傳輸需求殷切，
不論櫃內連結的 Switch Tray，或者機櫃間連接的乙太網路規格皆持續升級，另外
Agentic AI 亦帶動一般 server 快速成長，以 AMD 預期 2030 相關 CPU TAM 達
2000 以美元以上計算 CAGR 達 40-45%，且 Oak Stream 新平台下料號升級至
M7，整體高階料號供給吃緊，以目前土建 1.-1.5 年，設備交期 0.5-1.0 年計算，
新產能最快開出時點落於 2028 年，預計 4Q26 大園擴增 30 萬張新產能總計月產
能達 615 萬張(+17.1%YoY)，2027 年在中山、昆山以及檳城產能擴充下年底月產
能達 930 萬張(+51.2%YoY)，2028 年年底更上看 1110 萬張(+19.4%YoY)，考量
規格升級以及高階料號潛在供給吃緊後台光電 2027-2028 年獲利成長具上調空
間 ， 預估稅後EPS 分別上調至 211.35 元(原估 159.73 元)及 339.22 元(原估 247.13
元)。

研 究  報 告                
義隆(2458.TT) 
產業：電子–半導體 
2H26 僅賴無人機支撐營運，動能受限 
 投資評價與建議 
2H26 NB客戶拉貨力道轉弱將壓抑整體營運動能，公司已通過1H26配發4.4
元，預估2026年配發7.4元，殖利率約4.6%，具下檔保護及優良⻑投標的。  
 重點評論分析 
3Q26 NB拉貨趨緩，營運將持續季減：客戶面臨缺料問題，拉貨將趨緩，營運
將較1H26辛苦，預估營收29.1億元，QoQ-9.3%，雖7/1全面漲價，漲幅約
5~10%，然仍持續面臨供應鏈成本壓力，預估毛利率47%，EPS 1.88元。 
僅賴非NB產品支撐營運 ， 2H26動能有限： 展望2H26 ， NB客戶面臨更大的CPU
與記憶體缺料問題，而義隆營收約90%以上與NB相關，因此營運也將受影響，
主要動能來自非NB產品的無人機：公司與中研院合作，利用自身演算法優勢，
推出Mini LED local dimming(區域調光)與ISP產品，1H26出貨以ISP為主，
ASP約5~6美元，7月已開始出貨AI Box，ASP約300~500美元，已通過雷虎測
試並開始出貨，2H26 ASP將明顯提升，將成為2026年最成⻑動能，更有望推
升2026年AI產品線挑戰雙位數營收占比 。 整體而言 ， 2H26營運僅仰賴非NB產
品支撐，然NB拉貨力道趨緩仍將壓抑整體營運動能，展望2027年，隨著缺料
問題逐步改善，NB有望逐步回復拉貨動能，搭配基期較低的無人機產品持續
成⻑，營運成⻑性將優於2026年。 
 投資風險

### Page 2

2

| 營運概況  
2Q26費用較高導致本業獲利低於預期，因業外金融評價利益使得獲利優於預期：NB拉貨力道趨緩，僅AI受惠無
人機產品出貨成⻑，2Q26營收32億元，QoQ-0.6%，因供應鏈成本提升，毛利率47.4%，費用因提列較高員工酬
勞而提升至8.2億元，高於往常約7~8億元，業外約85%來自金融評價利益(多數來自投資旭暉(6698))，EPS 3.07
元，優於預期。 
3Q26 NB拉貨趨緩，營運將持續季減：客戶面臨CPU、記憶體缺料問題，拉貨將趨緩，營運將較1H26辛苦，且先
前連四季業外金額變動較大，故不提供財測，預估營收29.1億元，QoQ-9.3%，雖7/1全面漲價，漲幅約5~10%，
然仍持續面臨供應鏈成本壓力，預估毛利率47%，EPS 1.88元。 
NB面臨缺料問題，僅賴非NB產品支撐營運，2H26整體動能有限：展望2H26，NB客戶面臨更大的CPU與記憶體
缺料問題，而義隆營收約90%以上與NB相關，因此營運也將受影響，公司看法也由前次法說的不悲觀轉為營運較
1H26辛苦，主要動能來自非NB產品，1)彩色電子書：為電子書產業注入新希望，公司目前已打入第二與第三大電
子書客戶，也積極爭取第⼀大客戶，2026年出貨有望年增；2)無人機：公司與中研院合作，利用自身演算法優勢，
推出Mini LED local dimming(區域調光)與ISP產品， 1H26出貨以ISP為主， ASP約5~6美元， 7月已開始出貨AI Box ，
ASP約300~500美元，已通過雷虎測試並開始出貨，目前僅作前端光學模組，2026年底將推出避障功能，四鏡頭
方案約500美元，十二鏡頭方案將達1,000美元，2H26 ASP將明顯提升，將成為2026年最成⻑動能，更有望推升
2026年AI產品線挑戰雙位數營收占比，且公司具備MIT優勢，將積極爭取國防訂單，未來具成⻑潛力。整體而言，
2H26營運僅仰賴非NB產品支撐，然NB拉貨力道趨緩仍將壓抑整體營運動能，展望2027年，隨著缺料問題逐步改
善，NB有望逐步回復拉貨動能，搭配基期較低的無人機產品持續成⻑，營運成⻑性將優於2026年。 
2H26營運動能受限，維持中立評等，惟1H25配發現金股利4.4元，為良好⻑投標的：2H26 NB客戶拉貨力道轉弱
將壓抑整體營運動能，公司已通過1H26配發4.4元，預估2026年配發7.4元，殖利率約4.6%，具下檔保護及優良⻑
投標的。

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: ASPEED announced its 2Q26 results today (5 August).

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat on higher GM. Net income was 
TWD1.84bn (EPS: TWD44.27), which is 9-18% above our estimate 
(TWD1.56bn) and the Bloomberg consensus (TWD1,68bn), respectively. 
Gross margin increased by 2.8pp QoQ to 72.0% (vs. 69.2% in 1Q26), 
better than investors’ expectation on price increases for its products to pass 
through additional BT substrate costs. Strength was slightly offset by a 
higher employee stock-based bonus in 2Q26. Net profit was boosted by a 
higher non-operational gain of TWD180m, which could be FX gains.

Business outlook. We believe most investors are worried about the 
overbuilt BMC in 2026, as they cannot see a significant jump in regular 
server shipments in 2026 (likely 15-20% YoY). We expect ASPEED’s BMC 
shipment volume to be at 30.5/36.1m (66%/19% YoY) in 2026/27 (vs. prior 
estimates of 29.4/34.7m), as we continue to see a better-than-expected 
quarter sales run rate. We expect solid regular server and AI demand 
ahead to provide market strength, although we consider some earlier pull-in 
in 2H26 given regular server shipment growth seems to be capped by a 
component shortage. We expect AI and non-AI servers to consume 
12m/19m of BMC shipments, respectively, in 2026 and 16m/20m in 2027 
due to a new CSP AI server contribution and a GPU client increasing its 
product offerings from the next generation.

Although the current run-rate for ASPEED’s BMC shipment seems to be 
higher than market demand, we believe the potential excess inventory 
should be less than 3m (<10% of shipment), in line with the historical 
pattern. We also expect ASPEED to maintain its positive tone on shipments 
in 2H26 given support from back-end OAST vendors from 4Q26 and solid 
demand ahead. We believe the GM increased in 2Q26 due to its own price 
hikes, but we expect it to gradually decline QoQ in 2H26 on ongoing price 
hikes by substrate vendors. Based on our understanding, ASPEED is still 
negotiating another round of price hikes for substrates for 2027. Hence, the 
GM dilution we expect in 2027 would be due to the AST2700 ramp. Before 
shipment meets critical mass, we believe the GM would be suboptimal.

What we recommend: We lift our 2026-28E EPS by 8-12% to factor in our 
higher BMC shipment assumptions. We lift our 12M TP to TWD19,800, 
based on an unchanged 66x PER (high end of its past-3-year range of 21-
78x) on our 1-year forward EPS forecast. Key risk: weak AI server demand.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 2-3% higher than the Bloomberg 
consensus, likely due to our bullish view on ASPEED’s ASP and shipment.

5 August 2026

2Q26 results: gross margin a surprise

➢ 2H26 outlook remains promising with likely higher margins  
➢ Potential inventory build is still healthy and under control  
➢ Reaffirming our Buy (1) rating; raising our 12-month TP to TWD19,800

Company profile 
Established in November 2004, Aspeed is a fabless IC design company specialising in baseboard 
management controllers (BMCs), which are mostly used for the remote management of servers. Aspeed 
is a global leader in BMC, with about 70% market share. Its other products include PC/AV extension 
SoC, which supports the extension of digital signals of PCs or multimedia content to remote terminals; 
and Cupola360, which is a spherical image processor that supports 360-degree cameras.

2Q26 GM strong beat, yet OpM miss on higher opex 
Aspeed reported its 2Q26 preliminary results (see Exhibit 1) on 5 
August. 2Q26 GM of 72.0% (+282bps QoQ) came in much stronger 
vs. GSe/Bloomberg consensus of 69.6%/68.6%; we attribute the 
strong sequential increase to higher BMC pricing that reflects rising 
component and OSAT cost. However, 2Q26 opex ratio also came in 
higher at 18.1% (+166bps), which was above GSe/Bloomberg 
consensus of 14.6%/14.3%, mainly impacted by higher cost from 
cash-settled stock units (CSUs) that are linked to share price 
movements as seen in previous quarter.  
3Q26 GM to soften before rebounding on higher pricing in 4Q26 
Management maintained its 3Q26 revenue guidance of 
NT$4.1-4.3bn (+6%-11% QoQ), with GM in the range of 67-68%, 
implying a sequential decline. We maintain our view that Aspeed’s 
3Q26E revenue will grow further at 22% QoQ, supported by 
sustained demand from US CSP customers and the gradual easing of 
the substrate bottleneck. On the margin front, we expect 3Q26E GM 
to decline sequentially to 69.4% (from 72.0% in 2Q26), owing to a 
continued rise in material costs. However, against this rising cost 
backdrop, we now anticipate Aspeed to potentially implement 
another round of price adjustments in 4Q26, passing on the higher 
material costs. Overall, we expect 4Q26E GM to rebound to 70.6% 
on higher BMC pricing, with full-year 2026E GM reaching 70.3% (vs. 
69.5% previously). 
Multiple drivers reinforce a solid multi-year growth outlook 
We see a structurally stronger growth trajectory for Aspeed into 
2028, driven by 1) robust agentic AI demand, where we continue to 
see upside to AI-related general server BMC demand vs. 
management’s prior guidance of around 8.5mn/12.3mn in 
2026/2027E, supported by robust in-house CPU and general server

### Page 7

Investment Thesis, Price Target Risks and Methodology

Investment Thesis - Aspeed (5274.TWO) 
Aspeed is a leading Taiwan-based IC (integrated circuit) design company specializing in 
BMC (baseboard management controller) SoC, which is used to remotely monitor the 
physical state of servers. The company is the largest BMC supplier, with c.70% of the 
global BMC market share, and 85% of its total revenue comes from the BMC segment. 
We like Aspeed as we expect its revenue/earnings CAGRs to further accelerate to 
78%/88% in 2025-2028E (vs. 5.9%/4.9% during 2019-2023), driven mostly by AI server 
demand, especially started from 2025. Furthermore, we also expect server architecture 
changes will bring more business opportunities to Aspeed to drive up its TAM expansion 
within the server market. With more TAM expansion and more dollar content growth 
within the AI theme, we continue to see upside potential for its revenue and earnings 
growth. We have a Buy rating on the name. 
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Aspeed (5274.TWO) 
Valuation: Our 12-month TP of NT$22,000 is based on a target P/E of 40x (in line with 
its 10-year historical trading average) applied to our 2028E EPS, and discounted back to 
2027E at 13.6% CoE. Our key assumptions for CoE include: (1) 1.5x beta (sourcing 
Bloomberg), (2) a 4.25% risk-free rate, and (3) a market risk premium at 6.25% (in line 
with GS house view). 
Key downside risks to our view and TP: 1) A softer-than-expected server market 
demand recovery, 2) slower-than-expected BMC penetration within AI servers, 3) 
intensifying market competition.

MPI – We expect  25-30% 3Q revenue growth Q/Q; CPO insertion test progress

going well: MPI reported strong 2Q preliminary revenue up 33% Q/Q, 6% above

Google TPU, with additional contributions from networking and DDIC. We expect
strong AI demand to sustain this momentum. We see a price hike across all product
lines driving 3Q revenue, with margin reaching ~60% amid relatively less CPC
exposure. Our checks indicate that none of MPI's equipment has been disqualified in

the insertion test flow, with insertion 3 prober on track to ship in 4Q and insertion 2
likely to start in mid-27. MPI will host an on-site earnings call on August 14, with key
focus on the MEMS probe pin capacity expansion plan, CPO progress and revenue
targets, and key AI GPU/ASIC market shares.
Winway – 3Q revenue seen topping 20% Q/Q, with 2H margin likely to recover
to 43-45%: Although 2Q preliminary revenue tracked in line with expectations, GM

was likely below 40%, potentially from a higher smartphone (plastic socket) mix; we
monitor demand from low-cost models, stronger MEMS probe card contributions,
and writing off defective products during the new capacity ramp. As all new capacity
comes online, We expect Winway to fulfill all backlog into year-end, with stable
yield and a better product mix in sockets and probe cards stabilizing 2H GM at 43-
45%. Winway plans to release earnings on 6 Aug after the market close.

Raising MPI PT to NT$8,000, cutting Winway to NT$12,000: We increase our MPI
near-term estimates due to stronger CPC/MEMS demand and price-hike benefits
that will likely be sustained into 2027. We expect the stock to trade at 50x 2027e
EPS with an earnings CAGR of 112% for 2025-28, vs. 36x now. On the other hand, we

from 16.4%, to reflect unstable GM; our new PT implies 58x 2027e EPS (currently

Details of MPI Business Development
Capacity
With a view toward meeting strong demand from customers, MPI intends to further
increase its capacity substantially into 2026-27, in particular for MEMS probe cards. Its
plan was to expand its VPC capacity from 1.2mn pins per month to 1.5mn in 2Q26,  and it
expects a further increase to 2mn per month in 4Q26. For MEMS, the company plans to
expand capacity from 2.0mn pins per month to 2.5mn in 2Q26 and 3.5mn in 4Q26, which

should help it  further expand share in that market. Looking to 2027, management expects
MPI to expand total VPC and MEMS capacity by 60% to around 8.8mn pins per month,
with MEMS expansion magnitude outpacing VPC. However, with more new facilities and
land purchased recently, we do not rule out its MEMS capacity reaching 8-10mn pins per
month, with our bull case extending beyond 10mn.
Order visibility and contract liabilities vs. revenue
Management said during the most recent earnings call said that it expects its B/B ratio for

all product lines to stay above 1 during 2026. Currently, order visibility for MPI has
stretched from one quarter (historical average) to nine months. Additionally, contract
liabilities rose 44% QoQ and 58% YoY in 1Q26, reaching 59% of revenue, indicating
aggressive pre-payments from customers and helping to solidify future revenue streams.

MPI: Estimate Revisions and Financials
We lift our EPS estimates, factoring in stronger-than-expected 2Q26 revenue and 2H26
guidance. We expect the ongoing ramp of AI ASIC such as Trainium and networking, strong
momentum in traditional non-AI business such as DDIC, and newly gained non-AI ASIC
customers to continue bear fruit in the near term. CPO equipment shipment should start
shipping in 2H26, with the newly purchased fab targeting CPO equipment production

helping to sustain growth momentum into 2027-28. The GM increase is seen driven mainly
by more shipments of MEMS probe cards as well as the price hike conducted across probe
card product lines starting 3Q26.

MPI: Valuation Methodology
We lift our price target from NT$7,500 to NT$8,000: This factors in our 2026-28
estimate increases and a slightly decrease in the payout ratio from 75% to 67% for R&D
investment. Other key RI models are unchanged, including a cost of equity of 9.78% (risk-
free rate 2.0% and risk premium 6.0%), intermediate growth rate of 16%,   and terminal
growth rate of 4.0%. Our price target implies P/Es of 52x 2027e and 27x 2028e P/E, and

we see valuation continuing to improve along with rising earnings. Our bull and bear case
scenario values rise from NT$10,000 and NT$4,000 to NT$11,000 and NT$5,000,
respectively, implying 69x and 31x 2027e EPS.

Winway: Valuation Methodology
We cut our price target from NT$15,000 to NT$12,000, reflecting our estimate changes
and a reduced intermediate growth rate from 16.4% to 13.2% due to unstable GM impact.
Our RI parameters are unchanged, including 9.14% cost of equity (risk-free rate 2.0% and
risk premium 5.5%), a payout ratio of 80%, and a terminal growth rate of 4.5%.                   We derive
our price target from a residual income model, as we believe this can best capture long-

term value. Our bull and bear case scenario values decline from NT$18,000 and NT
$9,000 to NT$14,400 and NT$6,400, respectively, implying 69x and 31x 2027e EPS.

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

2Q26 results beat on stronger margins — Sales rose 21% y/y and 6% q/q to 
NT$4.8bn, 2% above our estimate, while net income grew 33% y/y and 20% q/q to 
NT$1.1bn, beating our/BBG estimates by 12%/16%. The key positive surprise was 
GPM, which expanded 3.0ppt q/q to 39.1%. We believe the improvement was likely 
driven by a better product mix, particularly a higher contribution from higher power 
rating BBU products, together with stronger fixed-cost leverage as shipment volume 
increased. The margins beat suggests potential upside risk to our and BBG full year 
earnings forecasts. 
July-26 sales provide further evidence of robust BBU demand — Sales reached 
another record high of NT$1.7bn, up 28% y/y and 2% m/m, extending the sequential 
growth momentum seen since March. The solid monthly performance following a 
strong 2Q suggests that demand remains healthy.    
Implications — AES's strong results and solid July-26 sales reinforce our positive 
view on the BBU sector, supported by sustained AIDC infrastructure buildout, 
increasing BBU content and an ongoing shift toward higher-power products. The 
solid GPM expansion is also an encouraging read-across for Dynapack, our preferred 
BBU stock. It suggests meaningful room for Dynapack's profitability to improve as its

Advanced Energy Solution
Valuation
Our target price of NT$1,680 is based on 27x 2026E EPS on par with its historical average since listing and supported by a
2025-28E earnings CAGR of 27%. We use 2027E as the year of valuation base as we think 2027E can better reflect its earnings
power after the commercializarion of HVDC products.
Risks
Key downside risks to our earnings forecasts that could prevent the shares from reaching our target price include: 1) slower-

than-expected end demand from e-Bikes post the pandemic and volaitlity in cloud capex deployment that could impact
datacenter BBU sales; 2) component supply constraints/logistics challenges, which could lead to slower-than-expected
shipment and top-line momentum; and 3) peer competition, which could impact sales growth and margins negatively, in our
view.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

Summary: Eclat posted its 2Q26 results and monthly revenue for July on 6 August 2026 
after market hours. Its 2Q26 basic EPS of TWD5.66 was in line with our estimate 
(TWD5.55) but missed the Bloomberg consensus estimate by 7.6%. Its 2Q26 gross margin 
came in at 30.0%, also in line with our (30.0%) but missed the consensus (31.1%) 
estimates. The company plans to have an investor conference on 18 August, and we will 
provide an update then.

We have a Buy (1) call and 12-month TP of TWD560, based on a target PER of 22x 
applied to our one-year forward EPS estimate. Please see our latest flash note, 1Q26 
results review: solid 2026 outlook on 19 May 2026, for more information on the company.

What’s the impact 
• 2Q26 results: missed market expectations. Eclat’s 2Q26 revenue of TWD10,086m 
(+4.8% QoQ and +3.8% YoY) was in line with our and the consensus estimates. Its 
1Q26 gross margin came in at 30.0% (vs. 32.2% in 1Q26 and 25.7% in 2Q25), in line 
with our (30.0%) but missing the consensus (31.1%) estimates. However, with higher-
than-expected personnel expenses, its operating margin of 19.2% (vs. 22.8% in 1Q26 
and 15.4% in 2Q25) missed our estimate (20.2%) and the Bloomberg consensus 
(21.2%), respectively. Therefore, its operating profit of TWD1,935m (-11.8% QoQ and 
+28.9% YoY) missed our and the consensus estimates by 6.5% and 10.7%, 
respectively. With FX gains of c. TWD28m, its net profit came in at TWD1,553m (-
15.4% QoQ and +158.3% YoY), in line with our estimate but missed the consensus 
estimates by 8.0%. Its 2Q26 basic EPS was TWD5.66.

• Recap: 2026 order outlook and gross margin guidance. Its order visibility remains 
at 6 months, and the company aims to deliver monthly revenue of TWD3bn+ for the 
remaining months of 2026. Despite the inflationary environment in the US, the 
company believes order placement momentum remains intact. The order outlook from 
its key clients is largely on track, with some rush orders in between, despite macro 
uncertainty. The latest gross margin guidance for 2026 is still 28-32%. Its mid- to long-
term revenue drivers are new product development (including functionality upgrades 
and high value-added products) on top of its innovation capability.

What we recommend 
We have a Buy (1) call and 12-month TP of TWD560, based on a target PER of 22x 
applied to our one-year forward EPS estimate. The stock is currently trading at PERs of 
14.7/13.5x, based on our 2026/27E EPS, vs. its past-3-year trading range of 12-26x. Key 
downside risks: slower-than-expected gross-margin expansion, lower-than-expected 
demand, and inflation.

Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-08-06
Pages: 7
Status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: We provide updates after 2Q26 results released on 6 August.

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat on revenue and gross margin. 
King Slide’s 2Q26 earnings came in at TWD7.1bn (EPS: TWD74.4), 72% 
and 45% above our and street expectations, respectively, driven by the 
higher-than-expected revenue and gross margin. Revenue was 
TWD10.8bn (up 99% QoQ and 156% YoY), beating expectations by 23-
51% on increasing market share in the regular server segment and higher-
than-expected ASPs per rail kit due to spec upgrades. The gross margin 
increased by 9.7pp QoQ on an improved ASP trend. The operating margin 
improved 15.0pp to 82.1% on the gross margin increase and opex control. 
Lastly, net profit was slightly impacted by the FX loss and higher tax rate.

Business outlook. After a strong beat in 2Q26, we believe King Slide is 
proving its dominance in the server market, even though we believe 
hyperscalers and key AI OEMs will likely introduce new suppliers in the rail 
kit market. We expect King Slide to still control a c.75% market share in 
Nvidia’s supply chain and other ASIC-based AI servers, although we expect 
its share in Nvidia to decline from c.100% to c.75% from 2027. However, 
we lift our assumption for King Slide’s market share for regular servers from 
c.60% to c.80%, especially from one particular CSP client, from 2Q26. We 
also lift the regular server rail kit ASP from USD30-40 to USD60-70, given 
the new CPU platform launch and an improving product mix, which raises 
our gross margin assumptions to 85-90% from 70% for 2026-28E. Given 
the upward revisions to ASP and market share assumptions in the regular 
server market, we lift our earnings forecasts by 73-149%. We see some 
new AI server and relevant racks as key growth drivers, and include 
c.10,000 CPU racks for Nvidia and c.8,000 Helios racks for AMD in our 
2027 forecasts. We also believe that within the current trend, we will see 
switch rack, power rack and BBU rack volumes gradually picking up, but 
quantifying the volumes is difficult so we have not factored them into our 
model; therefore, these items (i.e. switch rack, power rack, BBU rack) 
would offer upside to our current forecasts.

What we recommend: We raise our 2026-27E EPS by 73-149% to factor 
in the 2Q26 results. We raise our 12M TP to TWD15,000, based on a PER 
of 36x (prior: 30x; higher than its past-3-year range of 9-23x) on our 4-
quarter forward EPS forecast, to reflect a higher earnings trajectory. Thus, 
we reaffirm our Buy (1) rating. Key downside risk: weaker-than-expected AI 
server demand.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 47-65% above the Bloomberg 
consensus as we are more positive on its revenue and profitability.

6 August 2026

2Q26 results: strong beat and an improving outlook

➢ Share gains in regular servers were the key growth driver in 2Q26  
➢ Increasing ASP trend is key to gross margin expansion 
➢ Reaffirming our Buy (1) rating; lifting 12M TP to TWD15,000

Company profile 
Founded in 1986, King Slide Works started as a rail kit manufacturer. Leveraging its years of 
mechanism design experience, the company soon started manufacturing server rail kit in 2000. With 40 
years of development, King Slide’s product portfolio now comprises server rail kit, kitchen rail kit and 
hinge. The company is headquartered in Kaohsiung city with two production sites including King Slide 
Works Co., LTD (ball bearing slide and hinge) and King Slide Technology Co., LTD (server rail kit and 
functional kitchen rail kit). King Slide also owns sales offices in the US and China. It was listed on the 
Taiwan Stock Exchange in 2008.

### Page 1

Summary: NYPCB released its 2Q26 results after market hours on 6 August. The earnings 
of TWD2.26bn (EPS: TWD3.50) are slightly lower than our expectation on a higher tax rate 
(24% vs. 18% in 1Q26). That said, core business was on track with our expectations. 
Looking ahead, we expect NYPCB to continuously increase its ASP (especially for BT 
substrate), which would lead to both revenue increase and margin expansion in 2H26. We 
currently forecast c.20%/10% revenue QoQ growth in 3Q26/4Q26 with gross margins 
expanding to c.30/35%. Separately, NYPCB also announced it will invest TWD46.8bn to 
construct a high body size and high layer count of substrate, which we believe to be on-line 
from 2029. We are currently reviewing our model and would provide updates in due 
course. We have a Buy (1) rating on NYPCB, with a 12-month TP of TWD2,444, based on 
a target PER of 49x, applied on 1-year-forward EPS.

What’s the impact: 
Below are our read-throughs from NYPCB’s 2Q26 results (released on 6 August).

• 2Q26 results first-take: results beat on pull-in demand. NYPCB released its results 
after market hours on 6 Aug, with net income of TWD2.26bn (EPS: TWD3.50), missing 
our expectations by 7% due mainly to a higher-than-expected tax rate. 2Q26 sales 
(TWD13.6bn; +21% QoQ; +42% YoY) was largely on track with our and street’s 
expectations due to price hikes. As such, gross margin also improved by 8.9pp QoQ to 
24.7% in 2Q26 (largely on-track with our estimate of 24.3%). With slightly better 
operating leverage, operating margin improved by 9.3pp QoQ to 21.4%. That said, net 
profit was dragged by a higher tax rate of 24% (vs. 18% in 1Q26).

• Business outlook. Looking ahead, we remain positive on the substrate industry given 
the  current S-D situation. We expect NYPCB to continuously increase its ASP 
(especially for BT substrate), which would lead to both revenue increase and margin 
expansion in 2H26. We currently forecast c.20%/10% revenue QoQ growth in 
3Q26/4Q26 with gross margins expanding to c.30/35%. Separately, NYPCB also 
announced it will invest TWD46.8bn to construct a high body size and high layer count 
of substrate, which we believe to be on-line from 2029. We are currently reviewing our 
model and would provide updates in due course.

AWSC’s 2Q26 core business OP was NT$290mn, which was lower 
than both GSe/BBG consensus of NT$350mn/327mn, mainly due to 
the hike in raw material cost, leading to a 30.0% GM (lower than 
GSe/BBG consensus GM of 34.8%/32.6%), despite UTR in 2Q26 
remaining stable at 65-70%. Moreover, AWSC reported NI of 
NT$278mn, which was in line with GSe but 7% lower than BBG 
consensus while tax rate is lower (9% vs. 17% in 1Q26) due to tax 
credit from R&D. 
Going into 3Q26, we believe the company’s revenue will decrease by 
3% and the solid pull in demand from Korean smartphone suppliers 
will be offset by the weaker demand from lower-end smartphone. 
Moreover, we expect the company’s utilization rate to remain stable 
at 65-70% in 3Q26 and its GM to go down to 25.6% (down 4.4ppt 
QoQ) driven by higher raw material costs. 
We expect the rise in material costs will continue to have a negative 
impact on AWSC’s profitability, as the company is securing raw 
materials at higher cost as low-cost inventory has been depleted 
following the strong demand pull-in during 1H26. Despite the 
company continuing to negotiate a pricing increase with clients, we 
remain cautious on the low-end segment within the cellular business 
as customers are more price-sensitive. 
For AI-related business, the company will continue to ship VCSEL 
products for 400G/800G optical transceiver this year, and we 
expect revenue contribution to be <2% in 2026E. The company 
continues to make progress on the new PD (Photodiode) product 
and is currently undergoing verification with a major customer, while 
the company is also engaging with several potential customers. The 
company expects PD products to make more contribution starting 
in 2H27 given its long verification process (typically 6-12+ months).

### Page 3

We reiterate our conservative view on the cellular/WiFi PA industry (see here) as we 
continue to see weaker smartphone shipment (-10%/+3%/+1% in 2026/27/28, see 
here) as end demand continues to be impacted by the elevated memory price (see here). 
For AWSC, we believe the company’s superior cost control capability and higher 
production yield relative to peers should continue to support market share gains among 
China PA design houses as Chinese clients increasingly shift toward higher-end PA 
products. In addition, AWSC has continued to expand its market share with the Korean 
smartphone brand, which we believe will continue to drive in its cellular business over 
the coming quarters/years. Overall, we expect AWSC to continue gaining share from its 
key competitors due to (1) its strategic focus on China and US PA design houses, and (2) 
its competitive pricing strategy, supported by a more favorable cost structure comparing 
to its key competitor, Win Semi (AWSC/Win Semi’s fixed cost accounts for 30%/40% of 
the total, while Win Semi’s COGS per wafer ~130% higher than AWSC’s). 
We continue to see recovery in 2026 CAPEX plans among Taiwan PA foundry players, but 
we do not view this as an indication of a meaningfully stronger demand outlook as the 
capital spending is more related to new AI businesses. AWSC reiterated its 2026 CAPEX 
at NT$500-600mn and further expect CAPEX to increase in 2027/28. Management 
continue to expect UTR to reach at most ~70% in 2026, implying no need for capacity 
expansion in the near term. 
Overall, we maintain our Neutral rating on AWSC with a new 12-m TP of NT$147 (from 
NT$143) as we roll over our valuation period by one quarter.

### Page 5

Earnings revisions  
We revise down our 2026/27 revenue by 5/4% to factor in a more conservative outlook 
for the low-end segment within the cellular business but revise up our 2028 revenue by 
1% with more AI-related revenue; we revise down 2026/27/28E GM estimates by 
0.9/0.4/0.3ppt to reflect the negative impact from rising material cost. Overall, we 
revise down 2026/27E earnings by 10/4% and revise up 2028E earnings by 1%.

Valuation 
We maintain our Neutral rating and revise up our TP from NT$143 to NT$147, based on 
a 27x target PE (in line with the company’s past 10-year forward P/E multiple, and in line 
with the inventory build-up period average P/E), factoring in our earnings revisions and, 
consistent with our group coverage practices, rolling over our valuation period from 
2H26-1H27E to 4Q26-3Q27E.

### Page 6

Investment Thesis and TP & risks

AWSC is one of the largest GaAS foundries globally, with 10-15% market share in the 
GaAS foundry industry in 2025. We expect the company to enjoy solid share gain 
opportunity in the long term, considering its much lower than peers’ production cost 
and better production efficiency. However, given the high inventory level in the supply 
chain, and the slower-than-expected Android smartphone PA demand in coming 
quarters, we expect relatively slow profit growth in the near term. 
We are Neutral rated given the company’s relatively slow profit growth in coming 
quarters. We think the stock is priced fairly, trading at its historical upcycle average P/E 
multiple, despite the long-term market share growth opportunity. We forecast AWSC’s 
net income to grow at a 34% 2026-28E CAGR. The key up/downside risks are (1) 
easing/rising competition in the China PA foundry market, (2) 
faster/slower-than-expected progress on 5G/WiFi 7 upgrade trends, and (3) 
faster/slower-than expected progress with new businesses, including LEO satellite, 
drones and datacom.  
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$147 is based on a target 27x 
4Q26-3Q27 P/E, which is in line with the company’s past 10-year forward P/E multiple 
and the inventory build-up period average P/E. We consider this multiple appropriate 
given the soft demand outlook and our positive view on the company’s longer-term 
share gain opportunity. 
The key up/downside risks are 1) easing/rising competition in the China PA foundry 
market, (2) faster/slower-than-expected progress on 5G/WiFi 7 upgrade trends, and (3) 
faster/slower-than expected progress with new businesses, including LEO satellite, 
drones and datacom.

M
Idea
2Q26 OP above consensus: On the back of revenue at NT$95,538mn (+36% QoQ/
+58% YoY), GM expanded by 0.1ppt QoQ to 19.7% (vs. MSe of 20.2%/consensus of
19.2%) as tailwinds from a favorable product mix were largely offset by higher
component costs. With opex better controlled at NT$4,491mn (opex ratio 4.7% vs.
MSe 5.0%/consensus 4.3%), OP was NT$14,323mn (OPM 15.0%), 4%/9% higher than
MSe of NT$13,740mn (OPM 15.2%)/consensus of NT$13,083mn (OPM 14.9%),

respectively. Helped by non-op gains of NT$245mn, NP came in at NT$11,053mn
(EPS NT$19.78), 2%/6% higher than MSe/consensus of NT$10,815mn (EPS NT
$19.35)/NT$10,421mn (EPS NT$18.68).
Revenue momentum sustained into 3Q26: Off the strong revenues in 2Q26, we
expect Accton to continue growing sequentially into 3Q26 as it should benefit from
broader-based  migration to 800G network switches from both existing and new
customers.  Moreover, the ramp of the new AI accelerator model  from its major

customer should be in full swing. Judging from July monthly sales of NT$39,473 (flat
MoM/+72% YoY), we expect 3Q26 revenue to grow by +27% QoQ/+66% YoY to NT
$120,883mn. On the margin side, as elevated component costs linger amid tight
supply and its revenue mix could turn less favorable in 2H26, we expect GM to
contract slightly to 18.5% (-1.2ppt QoQ). Nonetheless, operating leverage could help
mitigate the margin pressure and hold operating margin at 14.2% (-0.8ppt QoQ).

Stay OW: We remain constructive on Accton as we think its is well positioned in the
AI capex cycle to benefit from networking and compute deployment. Furthermore, it
should not miss out on opportunities in rack level solutions, optical-based switches,
etc. We maintain OW with a PT of NT$3,500 (30x 2027 P/E).

### Page 6

M
Idea
6
Valuation Methodology and Risks
OW with PT of NT$3,500 (previously NT$3,800)
Price target (base case scenario value) –  NT$3,500 (-8%): Our new price target is based
on 30x our 2027 EPS estimate (33x previously). We lower our target multiple to factor in
recent market sentiment toward AI names. We see our target multiple supported by the
48% operating profit CAGR we project for 2025-28. This implies a PEG of 0.6 vs. its
average of 0.7 over 2019-25, when the stock was trading at a P/E of 22x for an operating

profit CAGR of 32%.
Bull case scenario value – NT$4,200 (-3%): We apply 36x to our base case EPS estimate
for 2027 (38x previously). This scenario reflects stronger demand for network switches in
both data center and enterprise applications as well as more orders for AI accelerator
modules.
Bear case scenario value – NT$1,800 (-8%): We apply 16x to our base case EPS estimate
for 2027 (17x previously). This scenario reflects lukewarm data center and enterprise

capex and continued dominance by merchant GPUs in AI servers.
Downside risks to our positive thesis
• Weaker data center capex

Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

### Page 1

ab 6 August 2026
Global Research
ASPEED Technology Inc
AI winner story unchanged; bright outlook in
2027
Strong Q2 GM driven by price increase; Q3 to beat guidance
Aspeed reported Q2 GM of 72.0%, above consensus and UBSe of 69.3%/69.4%. We
believe this is mainly from the April price adjustment. Looking ahead, we estimate Q3
GM at 69.4%, slightly above guidance of 67-68%. With resilient Cloud AI demand and
improving supply of BT substrate and backend into H226, we forecast Aspeed's Q3 sales

to be NT$4.49bn, up 16% QoQ , outperforming the company guidance of NT$4.1-
4.3bn. For the entire year, we now estimate Aspeed to ship 31.0m BMCs (or up 63%
YoY) in 2026E, up slightly from our prior estimate of 30.8m. For 2027, we see further
growth potential for Aspeed's BMC shipment to reach 44.6m BMCs, a 44% YoY
growth, underpinned by CPU, GPU and ASIC servers across the US and China.
Initial 2027 orders tracking healthily with better product mix

Looking ahead into 2027E, we think the supply situation should further improve for
Aspeed. 1) Most of AST2700 shipment in 2027 should be using E-glass based BT
substrate, and 2) second qualified OSAT partner to enable steadier capacity support for
growing demand across both AI and general servers. Product mix wise, AST2700's mix is
on track to pick up meaningfully in 2027E, and should reach 26% of total shipment for
the year, generating a better blended ASP profile with AST2700's US$22-25 pricing,

above that of AST2600's cUS$16. As for the latest product developments: 1) the new
SMC 1840 with integrated FPGA is on track to start meaningful shipment by year-end
2027E and will contribute to sales in 2028E. 2) The new standalone SMC with Caliptra
integrated, the AST1040, with higher ASP (around US$10 vs current product of US$6.5-
7) should be shipping from late 2026E to improve SMC ASP in 2027E.
Strength across AI and general server unchallenged

As we have elaborated in our prior report, structurally, we continue to view Aspeed as a
key beneficiary of the rising agentic AI and server CPU opportunity. We forecast BMC
unit TAM for compute board to reach 77m in 2030E from 21m in 2025, with a further
10%+ upside risk from switches and storages.  See Figure 1S e r v e r s '  B M C  T A M  a n a l y s i s for our TAM analysis. Into
2027, the company should  solidify its lead across its current customer base, and we

believe Nvidia's Rubin Ultra is on track to use the 2700 series BMCs, signaling better
blended product and pricing structure of BMCs for GPU servers, on top of growth from
general and ASIC servers.
Valuation: Reiterate Buy and maintain our price target of NT$22,000
We raise net profit estimates by 4%/9%/11% for 2026E/27E/28E , respectively.
However, our EPS estimates for 2026E and beyond are largely unchanged, after
factoring in the 10% higher share count effective this quarter. Our price target is based

on a 55x average 2027-28E PE and a long-term earnings CAGR of 34%.

Company Description
ASPEED is the world's largest baseboard management controller (BMC) chipset provider.
ASPEED introduced the first generation of server management processors in 2005. It acquired
Emulex Pilot's remote server management chip business in 2016. Besides server management

chipsets, ASPEED also produces PC/AV extension solutions and image processing system-on-
chips (SoCs). In 2023, server management chipsets accounted for 88% of total sales.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We derive our price target for Aspeed from PE valuation methodology relative to its historical
trading range.
We believe key upside risks for Aspeed include: 1) stronger-than-expected server demand,
particularly from hyperscalers and from AI servers with less crowding out of traditional

servers; 2) further market share expansion; 3) faster-than-expected server platform upgrades;
4) faster-than-expected progress in expanding the addressable content within servers.
We believe key downside risks for Aspeed include: 1) weaker-than-expected server demand,
particularly from hyperscalers; 2) market share losses or more intense industry competition; 3)
slower-than-expected server platform upgrades; 4) slower-than-expected progress in
expanding the addressable content within servers.

### Page 1

Giant (9921.TW)
Margins Reset Higher as Fundamentals Turn; Upgrade to Buy, TP 
NT$108
CITI'S TAKE 
We upgrade Ginat to Buy following a substantial 2Q earnings beat driven by 
stronger-than-expected margin improvement. We believe the margin 
recovery is sustainable, supported by new products ramp-ups, a richer OB 
mix, and improving demand from EU and China. Mgmt’s FY26 guidance – 
LSD sales decline, 20-21% GPM, 1-3% OPM – appears conservative given 
the 22.3% GPM achieved in 1H and improving regional trends. We raise our 
26-28E EPS by 11-12% and lift TP to NT$108 based on 18.5x NTM P/E. With 
channel inventory lean, demand gradually recovering and earnings visibility 
improving, we believe the worst is behind and see an attractive risk/reward. 
Upgrade to Buy – margin resilience creates earnings upsides — We upgrade Giant 
from Neutral to Buy as the key concerns underpinning our previous cautious view are 
beginning to ease. The substantial 2Q margin beat demonstrates that product mix 
improvement and new model launches can more than offset still-elevated operating 
expenses. We expect margins to remain at relatively high levels in 2H26E, supported 
by continued new product ramp-ups, and improving fundamentals in EU and China.
2Q26 results significantly exceeded expectations on margin expansion — 
Revenue rose 6% y/y to NT$16.7bn, beating our/BBG est by 6%/5% each. GPM 
expanded 3.8ppt y/y to 24.2%, higher than our/BBG, driven by a higher own-brand 
contribution, product mix optimization and strong sales of newly launched models. 
Despite opex rising 0.5ppy y/y, reflecting product launch, sports sponsorship, and 
WRO-related legal expenses, OPM improved to 6.0% from 2.8% in 2Q25. Net profits 
were NT$635mn (+234% y/y), beating our/BBG est by 147%/48% each. 
Improving fundamentals yet mgmt. guidance still looks conservative — Mgmt. 
expects FY26E sales to decline by LSD y/y with GPM of 20-21% and OPM of 1-3%. 
We see ample upside to this guidance particularly after GPM reached 22.3% in 1H26. 
EU sales grew in teens y/y in 2Q, supported by successful new model launches, while 
China also returned to teens growth amid improving demand and healthier channel 
inventory. Giant expects new OB models to sustain EU growth in 2H despite soft OE 
demand while China should maintain stable momentum. Although the pace of the 
industry recovery remains gradual, we believe lean channel inventories and 
improving sell-through suggest that the downcycle has passed its trough.

Earnings revisions and TP change — We raise our earnings estimates 11-12% for
2026-2028E mainly to reflect higher sales assumptions and stronger GPM
expansion on back of better product mix, which more than offsets higher opex
estimates. We lift TP to NT$108 based on 18.5x 2H26-1H27E P/E, at around the
midpoint of its historical trading range. We believe the valuation is justified by the
improving earnings trajectory, and better visibility into a gradual industry recovery.

Using the mid cycle rather the upper end multiple appropriately reflects the still-
slow recovery and lingering uncertainties surrounding US WRO.

Giant
Company description
Giant was founded in 1972 as an OEM manufacturer initially and established
its own brand in 1981, first marketed in Taiwan followed by Europe, North
America, and other markets. Giant is now the world’s largest bicycle
manufacturer with a roughly 4% global market share in terms of unit sales and
is also among the world’s largest brands. The company is the primary contract
manufacturer for the world’s largest brand, Trek, and it is the largest brand

among high-end bikes in China. Following Trek, Giant brand bikes rank
among the T op 3 in the US.
Investment strategy
We have a Buy rating on the shares. Giant's strong 2Q beat, driven by
substantial margin improvement, points to meaningful upside to our and
BBG estimates. We expect margins to remain at elevated levels in 2H26E,
supported by new products ramp-ups and improving fundamentals in EU and
China where sales grew in the teens in 2Q26.With channel inventories lean

and demand gradually recovering, we believe worst is behind.
Valuation
Our target price for Giant of NT$108 is based on a 2H26-1H27E P/E of 18.5x,
setting at the mid circle of the stock's historical range of 14-30x during pre-
Covid years (2014-2019).
Risks
Downside/upside risks that could cause the Giant shares to deviate from our
target price: 1) e-bike adoption being slower/faster than expected; 2)
prolonged negative/positive impact from inventory correction, 3) China

domestic demand turning weak/strengthening; and 4) supply chain
disruption from shipping issues.
If the impact on the company from any of these factors differs from our base
case expectations, the stock could have difficulty achieving our target price or
could increase more than we expect.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

King Yuan Electronics Co (2449.TW)

King Yuan Electronics Co
Company description
Founded in 1987, King Yuan Electronics Corp. (KYEC) mainly provides testing
services for the back-end process of semiconductor production globally. With
more than 30 years of industry experience, KYEC has built up firm
relationships with several leading global IC design/IDM customers. Its
headquarters and production facilities are both located in Taiwan, with sales

offices in North America, Japan, and Singapore.
Investment strategy
We rate KYEC as Buy. As a key testing service provider for AI GPU and ASIC
products, KYEC is well positioned to benefit from the significant AI growth
opportunity in the years to come. Currently, KYEC is the major final testing
service provider for its major customer's AI GPU, and we expect KYEC to
continue to secure its dominant share in its customer's upcoming AI GPU
product lines due to its specialty in burn-in testing, smooth product delivery

capability, and its strong business partnership with its customer. We are also
positive over the growth outlook of its smartphone business thanks to the
integration of AI functionality, leading to a better replacement cycle. We
believe KYEC's major customer in smartphone will benefit from an improved
product mix, which will result in longer testing times for the flagship SoC.
Valuation
Our target price for KYEC of NT$342 is derived using a DCF methodology.

Using Bloomberg data, we apply a risk-free rate of 4%, a risk premium of 5%,
and a beta of 1.4x for a 10.8% cost of equity. With 20% corporate tax and a
3.0% interest rate on its debt, our WACC for KYEC is 9.7%. We assume
terminal sales growth of 5%. We model its adjusted EBIT margin to gradually
improve from 23% in 2024 to c30% in 2035E. At our target price, the shares
would trade at 2026/27E P/B of 7x/5x and 2026/27E P/E of 41x/25x, in line
with its global peers.

Risks
Key downside risks that could prevent KYEC shares from reaching our target
price include: 1) weaker-than-expected end-demand for global
smartphone/consumer electronic products; 2) slower ramp for AI-related
products; 3) slower-than-expected demand recovery in the automotive and
base station sector; and 4) pricing pressure on increasing competition.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

Gold Circuit Electronics Ltd.  | Asia Pacific
July Sales up 21% M/M and 77%
Y/Y
We attribute the July revenue beat to:
• Ramp of Trainium 3 UBB PCB shipments, which started in late 2Q.
• Additional capacity coming online in Taiwan, Thailand and Suzhou, China.
• Continued pricing adjustments with customers.
• Potentially some delayed shipments from June.
July revenue reached 33% and 35% of and our consensus 3Q revenue estimates,
respectively, which implies upside to our and the Street's 3Q forecasts, as the ramp

of Trainium 3 PCB and increasing capacity could drive monthly revenue up m/m
throughout 3Q.
Stay OW:  The stock is currently trading at just 11.9x 2027e and 9.0x 2028e P/E,
which we view as attractive vs. its three-year forward P/E range of 7x to 25x and its
Chinese peers at 30x+. Stay OW.
GCE is scheduled to report 2Q26 results on August 11, after the market closes.

Key Takeaways
GCE reported July sales of NT$10.0bn (+21% m/m, +77% y/y), 17% above MSe.
GCE's July revenue was ahead of MSe and the Street, accounting for 33% and
35% of MSe and consensus estimates of 3Q26 revenues, respectively.
With new project ramp (T3), we believe monthly revenue should remain elevated
or grow m/m, so there should be upside to both MSe and Street.

Idea
3Q26/2026 revenue guidance cut from slower R-series XPU ramp and lower test
time: Management cut 3Q26 revenue growth guidance from up 10-15% Q/Q to high
single digits Q/Q because of a slower R-series XPU ramp at the largest customer.
The slower major product ramp also lowers the 3Q26 gross margin outlook to 36-
38% vs. 39.5% in 2Q26. Our recent checks suggest R-series XPU final test time
might ramp from  800-900 seconds, not much higher than the prior generation,

partly driving the 2026 full-year revenue growth guidance cut from >40% Y/Y to up
36-38% Y/Y, in our view. However, the company remains optimistic about a 4Q26
margin rebound  as  the R-series XPU ramps.
2027e revenue growth remains strong at >40% Y/Y given the TPU/CPU growth
and shipment push-out: Despite the short-term headwind, management reiterates
that AI demand in 2027 remains robust, including some shipments being pushed out
from 2H26 to 2027. Our AI demand breakdown (see Exhibit 3 ) suggests extremely

strong growth in both TPU and CPU demand in 2027, each accounting for 10-15% of
total revenue. We believe CPU demand should more than double from 2026;
MediaTek TPU is a new growth driver in 2027. We expect 2027 margin to be
sustained above 40% given rising utilization and  cost pass-through to customers.
Strong revenue rebound starting from 4Q26, suggest building positions on dips
before 4Q26: After a relatively muted 2Q26 and 3Q26, we expect a strong 4Q26

revenue rebound of 15-20% Q/Q, driven by: 1) R-series XPU ramp, 2) TPU ramp at
both Broadcom and MediaTek, 3) Google CPU with new capacity, and 4) flagship
smartphones. We suggest accumulating the stock ahead of 4Q26 if  the share price
drops from the guidance and test time miss.
Cut price target to NT$338 (implies 25x 2027e EPS) – but stay OW: We cut our
earnings forecast and price target in view of shipment push-outs and lower R-series
XPU test time. We still view our implied target P/E as attractive vs. its 2025-2028e

revenue CAGR of 35% and AI  revenue exposure of 40-50% in 2027.

Our detailed analysis of AI semi revenue contribution to KYEC: Overall, AI-related
offerings  contributed  25-30% to revenue in 2025; that may be >40% in 2026 (including
TPU and chip probing). Our recent checks suggest that  R-series XPU final test time might

ramp from  800-900 seconds, not much higher than the prior generation.
Further, we  break down the CPU demand from the major customer, including G-series  and
V-Series CPU. We expect sharp testing time improvement from c. 300 seconds to c. 700
seconds – CPU design and chip size are both getting more complicated as generation/
geometry migrates for heavier AI inferencing and orchestration workload. Those CPUs also
require burn-in for better performance.

Overall, we expect that B-series XPU could maintain momentum in 3Q26 despite the
ramp-up of R-series. Combining the new products like 3nm TPU and 2nm smartphone SoC
from MediaTek, we forecast strong revenue growth of >15% QoQ in 4Q26.  Overall
revenue from the largest  customer should be more than 40% of KYEC's total revenue in
2026.

Strong Google TPU demand: In our prior MediaTek report, we mentioned that we have

observed demand upside from Google TPU, contributing strong revenue growth for KYEC
in 2026 and 2027. We now  forecast total TPU shipments of 3.7mn for 2026 and >7mn for
2027. We believe TPU could account for 7-8% of KYEC's 2026 total revenue and slightly
above 10%  of 2027's, including final testing and part of chip probing. In addition,
MediaTek's  TPU will also adopt burn-in for its 3nm AI ASIC, which we believe will be the
trend for those AI chips –  burn-in and longer testing times are adopted to ensure chip

performance.
Strong Google CPU demand too: In our previous  GUC report, we mentioned that the
raised demand forecast  is not just for Google TPU but CPU as well.   We now forecast
Google CPU shipments of 1.5mn in 2026 and 3mn units in 2027. Our checks also indicate
that this Google CPU requests burn-in and system-level testing, which we believe could
generate 3-4% of 2027 revenue.
To sum up, we now forecast that Google-related demand could account for 10-15% of

KYEC's 2027 total revenue, including TPU, CPU, final testing, and part of chip probing (vs.
8-10% of total revenue in 2026).

High capex to meet customers' needs and future growth: The OSAT industry continues
to face challenges in keeping up with the robust growth: Looking back at 2025, KYEC had
already raised its capex twice, to NT$37bn. Now, with another jump in 2026 to NT$50bn,
the message is clear: testing demand is remarkably strong. We don’t rule out KYEC's

maintaining high capex into 2027. We believe testing demand from the major customer in
both Taiwan and the US is growing robustly.
For a breakdown of the NT$50bn capex, here are our assumptions:
• 50% –  construction/clean room build
• 20-30% –  testers
• 5-15% –  probers and handlers
• 5-15% –  burn-in
• 5-10% –  others
KYEC can sustain its high market share in AI chip final testing
ASEH (3711.TW, also OW-rated) will depend on Advantest's burn-in tool, and become a

minor second source (<20%) for major customer final testing in 2026, in our view. ASE is
also running out of capacity; most of what it has already is busy with chip probing (higher
margin than final test). Its cost structure   for burn-in is also much higher than KYEC's,
which designs its own burn-in ovens. We expect ASE's testing revenue opportunity to
come mostly from wafer-sorting (or chip-probing) outsourced from TSMC.
All in all, KYEC still has high market share in overall AI final testing demand, thanks to

strength from both AI GPUs and ASICs. We estimate that its AI-related testing business
will account for >40% of 2026 consolidated revenue, including the new business in  AI
ASIC  testing, such  as Google TPU (v8).

Valuation methodology
We cut our  price target from NT$369.52 to NT$338: We continue to derive our price
target (our base case scenario value) from a residual income model. Along with our
earnings estimate cut, our revised price target   mostly reflects a cut in our intermediate
growth rate from  11.5% to 10.5% because of the lower test time from the major product.

Our other key valuation  assumptions are the same: a cost of equity of 9.8% (risk premium
of 6%, risk-free rate of 2%, and beta of 1.3), and terminal growth rate of 3.0%.

$245 to NT$215, implying 30x and 15x our 2027e EPS, respectively.

FOCI Fiber Optic Communications Inc  | Asia Pacific
We Expect 2Q Earnings to Mark
the Near-Term Trough – Stay
OW
2Q EPS came in better than feared:
• FOCI reported a loss of NT$0.23, narrowing from a NT$0.98 loss in 1Q and
beating our estimate of a NT$0.35 loss.
• Revenue rose 12% Q/Q but fell 27% Y/Y, 7% above our estimate yet 1% below
consensus.
• GM slipped Q/Q to 0.2%, reflecting destructive testing impact for its FAU
ahead of mass production and overhead from the 24-hour automation FAU

line.
• OpM improved to -21.4% from -40.9% in 1Q. 1Q was affected by one-off
share issuance expense.
July sales were NT$171mn, +9% M/M and +12% Y/Y – mainly driven by SiPh NRE
revenue.

Key Takeaways
CPO revenue should start in 3Q, subject to the customer’s final schedule.
The new fab in Thailand, in charge of traditional business manufacturing, has

begun equipment move-in, with mass production starting in September.
We expect a continued revenue climb from July into 2027, as more than one
customer enters mass production.
FOCI will host its on-site earnings call in early September. We expect more
details on CPO development and the expansion plan.
We view 27x 2027e P/E as undemanding.

Wiwynn Corp  | Asia Pacific
2Q26 OpM in line with
expectations; stay OW
More details:
• 2Q GM was 9.3% (+200bps q/q), 120/90bps above MSe/Street, which we
attribute to a higher consignment model mix in the quarter.
• 2Q opex was higher, primarily from higher R&D expenses related to
upcoming new projects (+99% q/q), so OP came in at NT$20.2bn (+23% q/q,
+69% y/y), 7% below MSe but 2% above consensus. OpM is 7.3% (+160bps
q/q), while showing 70bps beat vs. our prior estimate and 30bps above the

Street, but we view it as in line because Wistron had already reported a few
days earlier and we were able to back out Wiwynn's OpM at ~7.3% already,
which we mentioned in our Wistron report here.
• Non-op losses also higher than expected, mainly owing to higher interest
expenses.
• Thus, NP came in at NT$15bn (+9% q/q, +53% y/y), for EPS of NT$80.55, 7%
below MSe but in line with the Street.

Key Takeaways
2Q GM is up 200bps q/q because no GB racks were shipped, and memory and
CPU were excluded from revenue and COGS for certain customers from April.

With Wistron reporting  some days earlier, Wiwynn's OpM could be backed out at
~7.3%, in line with expectations; see report.
It is a gen server supplier to three hyperscalers (MSFT, META, AMZN) and will
potentially supply to GOOG; also key supplier of AMD Helios racks for META/
ORCL.
Valuation attractive at 13x CY27e / 11x CY28e P/E vs. three-year historical range
of 6-20x.

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Yageo
Valuation
We set our target price at NT$1,450, based on 35x average 2027E-28E earnings. We value Yageo based on PE as we believe the
company’s earnings performance and industry dynamics would be the key focuses of the market. Our target multiple of 35x is
at the higher end of the trading range since 2022. During this period the company has gone through the cycles, successfully
integrated the acquired business to enhance its product offerings, and started to deliver stable margins and earnings.

Risks
Key downside risks to our target price and rating include: 1) slower-than-expected demand recovery; 2) intensified peer and
pricing competition; 3) execution risks associated with M&A integration and synergies; and 4) FX and interest rate fluctuations.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.
